front.evidence: Loaded July 2026 Promenade and West Street panoramas; opposing actual textured Google 3D views.
front.observed: Frontage groups, setbacks, broad storey counts and open entrances. Building volumes are provisional; individual facades are not reconstructed.

side.evidence: Four close 3D orbits plus the wider assembled seafront orbit.
side.observed: Royal Clifton returns, service blocks, lodging gaps and the Ocean Plaza groups. Hidden private wall positions remain uncertain.

rear.evidence: Opposing actual 3D views along West Street and across the seafront blocks.
rear.observed: Roof and rear projections, open courts and access lanes. No ground-level private courtyard survey.

roof.evidence: Actual textured 3D views, inspected from four directions.
roof.observed: Height groups and principal roof extents. Flat caps are upper height bounds; detailed roof geometry is deferred.

terrain.evidence: Actual Google 3D and aerials, dated street panoramas, Historic England landform description.
terrain.observed: Formal lowered lido, irregular planted northwest bank, raised Esplanade and broad access ramp. Metric heights remain estimates above the existing local datum.
